data.name: Emaan
data.gender_notes: Emaan is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Emaan refers to a strong and unwavering faith in Allah. It is a fundamental concept in Islam, emphasizing the importance of trust and conviction. The name Emaan carries the meaning “Faith and Belief” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Emaan usually hope their child will grow to embody faith and belief and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In the Quran, Emaan is described as the foundation of a believer's relationship with Allah, as stated in Surah Al-Baqarah, Verse 285.
data.etymology: Emaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Faith and Belief.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Emaan total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: إيمان
in_arabic.long_meaning: إيمان هو مصطلح قرآنى يعبر عن الاعتقاد بالله وملائكته ورسله وکتبه واليوم الآخر، وهو ركن من أركان الإسلام ويشير إلى القدرة على الثقة بالله تعالى

in_urdu.name: ایمان
in_urdu.long_meaning: ایمان ایک اسلامی terminolgy ہے جو الله تعالیٰ، اس کے فرشتوں، اس کے رسولوں، اس کی کتابوں، اور قیامت کے دن پر ایمان لانے کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے، یہ اسلام کے بنیادی ستون میں سے ایک ہے

in_hindi.name: ईमान
in_hindi.long_meaning: ईमान एक इस्लामी शब्द है जो अल्लाह, उसके फरिश्तों, उसके पैगंबरों, उसकी किताबों, और अंतिम दिन के बारे में विश्वास को दर्शाता है, यह इस्लाम के मूल सिद्धांतों में से एक है

in_pashto.name: ایمان
in_pashto.meaning: ایمان د الله تعالی پر اعتقاد
in_pashto.long_meaning: ایمان د یو اسلامی اصطلاح دی چی د الله تعالی، هغه ملائکه، هغه پیغمبران، هغه کتابونو، او قیامت د ورځ پورې ایمان اړولای شی، دا د اسلام د بنسټونو څخه دی

in_english.long_meaning: Emaan is an Islamic term that refers to the belief in God, His angels, His prophets, His books, and the Last Day, it is one of the fundamental pillars of Islam and holds significant spiritual and cultural importance in Muslim traditions

data.cultural_impact: Emaan plays a significant role in the Islamic culture as it is one of the essential foundations of the faith and is regarded as a desirable quality for every believer. It is a bond between Allah and His servants, and maintaining this bond is considered a crucial duty. In daily life, Emaan is exhibited through actions, speech, and conduct that reflect obedience and devotion to Allah.
data.spiritual_significance: Emaan has profound spiritual significance in Islam because it represents the inner connection between a person and their Creator. A believer with Emaan sustains an unshakable belief in Allah's existence, omnipotence, and benevolence, and trust in His divine plan for their life. This unwavering faith fosters a deeper, more authentic relationship with Allah. Thus, Emaan is essential for a balanced and fulfilling spiritual life in Islam.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Faith and Belief" symbolizes Emaan refers to a strong and unwavering faith in Allah. It is a fundamental concept in Islam, emphasizing the importance of trust and conviction.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Emaan serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of faith and belief.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Emaan bint Harith was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad and is known for her unwavering faith. The name Emaan carried significant weight in that era.
